svg.text: H 9.6 m · wings 11 m · lapis: the owner's call
48 hour marks; the four Ages' years
at right angles: it goes any way
Rims full of eyes, all round
Four faces: man, lion, ox, eagle
two spread, 11 m tip to tip
Echoes: it is a heartbeat early
rings of hour marks spread out
9.6 m from the lower wing tips to the
tallest ceiling is 5.2 m. It does not
fit, and it does not need to.
